description: Devau, Nicolas and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented train couples one or more vertical HYDRUS domains to three-dimensional MODFLOW flow and MT3DMS transport. Unsaturated-zone fluxes provide groundwater recharge, and modelled hydraulic heads update the HYDRUS water-table depth. A separate Fortran converter transfers flux and concentration time series to MT3DMS. The deposit supplies three executables and inputs for a theoretical long-term non-reactive tracer example with transient boundaries. This example is not presented as field validation or a demonstration of every reactive PFAS mechanism. Component availability and licences must be assessed separately from the deposit label. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
